sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). After a recent loss, Sandbach will be looking to return to winning ways against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are on a poor run. Four days later on Wednesday 7 October, Sandbach travel away to face Wednesfield Community (KO 19:45) in a midweek fixture. The following Saturday (10 October), Sandbach visit Allscott Heath away from home (KO 15:00) in their second fixture of the week.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town, on 20 points, face Dawley Town away on Saturday 3 October in a direct top-flight battle, before hosting Wednesfield Community at home on 10 October. AFC Bridgnorth (third, 19 points) travel to Eccleshall on 3 October, while Wolverhampton Casuals (joint fourth, 19 points) play at home against Wednesfield Community on the same day. Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) host Foley Meir on 3 October, then visit Crewe away on 10 October. In-form Barnton (fourth overall with recent wins) host Shawbury United away on 10 October, while struggling Shawbury United are on a six-game losing streak and travel to face them. Brereton Social play at home against Widnes Town on 3 October, then face another home fixture against Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October before travelling to Allscott Heath on 10 October. Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) travel to Brereton Social on 3 October, then play Market Drayton Town away on 10 October. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Sandbach on 10 October after hosting Telford Town away on 3 October. Market Drayton Town host New Mills on 3 October before visiting Widnes Town away on 10 October. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town on 3 October, then host Telford Town at home on 10 October. Allscott Heath host Crewe on 3 October before welcoming Brereton Social away on 10 October.
